claim_summary: Exact ordinary 2-domination and vertex-deletion stability formulas for every finite connected complete multipartite graph, including corrected complete-bipartite boundary cases.
integrity: The theorem is proved independently from the cited complete-bipartite stability proposition and explicitly records the mismatch at small biclique boundaries rather than importing that proposition as a premise.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite complete multipartite graphs and ordinary 2-domination. Finite enumeration is corroborative only; the arbitrary-order result is analytic. A poorly indexed equivalent result under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact 2-domination stability of complete multipartite graphs
